close_reason:
Removed ChatCreateInput::Channel variant and its match arm in chat_create. Spec verified independently:
- draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Chat line 436: Channel Chats are created via addChannels in Space/set
- §Chat/set lines 905-924: only direct + group kinds are documented as user-creatable
- §Space/set line 1161: server creates kind:"channel" Chat itself when processing addChannels

Doc comments on the enum and chat_create rewritten to redirect callers to SessionClient::space_update + SpacePatch::add_channels (already supported). Intra-doc-links use super::SessionClient / super::SpacePatch paths so rustdoc resolves them.

Public API break is acceptable: pre-1.0 + non-existent compliant server target for the removed variant. No tests, docs, examples, README, or PLAN.md referenced the variant — workspace grep clean.

Verified:
- cargo build -p jmap-chat-client clean
- cargo test --workspace (all green)
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean
- cargo fmt --all -- --check clean
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-chat-client --no-deps clean

Committed as a4278ca.
description: src/methods/chat.rs:227-249 (and mod.rs:828-837 for the variant decl): `ChatCreateInput::Channel` builds a `Chat/set` create with `kind: "channel"`. Per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Chat (line 436): 'Channel Chats are created as part of a Space via the addChannels patch key in Space/set. Their chatId is assigned by the server at that time.' Spec line 1161 confirms the server creates the kind:"channel" Chat record itself when addChannels is processed. Spec line 901-924 (Chat/set) only describes direct and group as user-creatable kinds. A spec-compliant server WILL reject this request (likely invalidProperties). Fix: remove the Channel variant from ChatCreateInput and the corresponding match arm; channel creation belongs in space_update via SpacePatch.add_channels (which the client already supports per commit 4915cdf). This is a public-API breaking change, but the variant produces wire requests no compliant server can accept.
title: ChatCreateInput::Channel emits Chat/set request the spec forbids
